guidance: Use AWS Backup to centralize and automate backups across AWS services (EBS, EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, EFS) via policy-based schedules and retention rules. Store backups in a separate account to isolate them from a primary environment compromise. For on-premises infrastructure, use cost-optimized storage like S3 Glacier.
how_to_check: Are backups taken for all critical applications and stored in a separate account? Is a retention policy defined and aligned with RPO/RTO objectives? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
